issues.issue: The report does print what this line is made of. General 1,794,589.98 = carline 2,243.50 + homestead 26,789.64 + property tax credit 1,756,529.76 + pro-rate MV 9,027.08 (p9). Bond 130,346.43 = carline 362.46 + homestead 4,538.46 + property tax credit 124,187.90 + pro-rate 1,257.61 (p16). Special Building 74.51 = pro-rate (p17). So 1,912,045.76 (99.3%) is homestead/property tax credit, which is state aid; only 2,605.96 is carline tax. Under the mixed-line rule the dominant category is intergovernmental/state aid, with review, or the line should be split by fund schedule. The review text saying 'no breakdown of this line printed' is wrong.
